entries.zh: 兜带；把东西揣入怀中藏带，藏匿某物
entries.en: to conceal something by stowing it away on one's person; to hide, conceal something

entries.zh: 容隐；纵容包庇他人作恶而不纠正、不举发
entries.en: to tolerate and conceal (wrongdoing); to allow evil to go uncorrected

entries.zh: 兜收；收留藏匿（收接并藏起逃匿之人或物）
entries.en: to take in and conceal; to receive and harbor
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（los ledi eroi 无法释读），释义依汉字「兜收」与音写栏判定。

entries.zh: 兜执；捉拿拘执、兜拢执住
entries.en: to seize, catch and hold; to detain
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（los ledieron，疑为 detuvieron/detenidos 一类），释义依汉字「兜执」判定。

entries.zh: 闭塞；堵塞闭绝（孔窍、门户、通路）
entries.en: to block up, shut off, obstruct (a passage or opening)
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（los ama 无法释读），闭塞义依汉字与音写栏判定。

entries.zh: 闪；闪身躲开、躲避藏匿
entries.en: to dodge aside; to slip away and hide oneself
entries.notes: 字头存疑（闪/闵），官话栏对音与字形不合，释义从闽南音写栏与西语 esconderse 判定为闪躲义。

entries.zh: 疑为「闪避」二字；闪躲回避
entries.en: to dodge, avoid (likely a two-character compound for dodging aside; recorded head character uncertain)
entries.notes: 字栏只记一形「玷[疑:玷/珂]」而音写栏为两音节，疑原为「闪避」二字，官话栏对音亦不合。

entries.zh: 避；躲避、回避躲藏
entries.en: to avoid, shun; to hide oneself
entries.notes: 闽南语原稿音写栏残缺，据汉字「避」与官话栏对音判定，义自可通故照常给出释义。

entries.zh: 行僻；绕行僻路、走开躲避
entries.en: to go aside, take a byway to avoid being seen; to turn aside

entries.zh: 逃避；逃走躲避
entries.en: to flee and avoid; to run away to escape
entries.notes: 字头「僻[疑:僻/避]」存疑，闽南音写栏疑衍一音节，据官话栏对音判定为逃避义。

entries.zh: 逃闪；逃走闪躲
entries.en: to flee and dodge away
entries.notes: 官话栏第二音节声调记号污损难辨，释义依汉字「逃闪」与西语 esconderse 判定。

entries.zh: 逃避；逃走躲开、遁避
entries.en: to flee, run away and escape; to evade

entries.zh: 走去藏避；逃走去躲藏（末字残损，释义存疑）
entries.en: to run off and hide oneself; to flee (final characters damaged)
entries.notes: 字头「珀[疑:珀/玷]」及两栏尾音写残损难辨，据西语 esconderse huirse 与「走去」判定大意。

entries.zh: 藏；躲藏、藏匿
entries.en: to hide, conceal (oneself or something)

entries.zh: 逃；逃走闪避（躲开打击）
entries.en: to flee, run off; to dodge the blow

entries.zh: 障〔字存疑〕；遮障、藏于背后遮蔽
entries.en: to screen, shelter behind; to block from view
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（疑为 esconder detrás a las espaldas）且字头「暲[疑:暲/障]」存疑，据音写栏与西语义判定。

entries.zh: 障后；遮蔽在身后、藏在后面
entries.en: to screen from behind; to hide at the back
entries.notes: 西语词头残损严重（esconder el dtdor v no）且字头存疑，据汉字「障后」与三音节音写判定。

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕疑为下者躲避上者，据西语义拟定
entries.en: the inferior to hide himself from his superior (per the Spanish headword; Chinese head obscure)
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（疑为 esconderse el inferior del superior），汉字栏「愷[疑:愷/愒]上」无法解通，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 伏；伏匿、俯伏躲藏、潜伏
entries.en: to lie prostrate, lie low; to hide, lie in ambush

entries.zh: 乱障〔字存疑〕；仓皇乱躲、胡乱遮藏（据西语「如盗贼般仓皇藏匿」）
entries.en: to hide in a panicked scramble, like a thief taking cover (head character uncertain)
entries.notes: 字头「暲[疑:暲/障]」存疑且闽南音写声调记号污损，西语词头亦有残损，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 吐头；探头、从藏身处伸出头来
entries.en: to stick out one's head; to peer out from hiding
entries.notes: 西语词头拼写残损（疑为 esconderse de temor sacando la cabeza），汉字「吐头」与音写栏互证尚清晰。

entries.zh: 潜；潜水潜藏（如鱼潜于水中）
entries.en: to submerge; to stay hidden under water (like a fish in water)

entries.zh: 僻；躲避不令人见〔原件残损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to hide, keep out of sight (Spanish headword damaged; phonetic column ambiguous)
entries.notes: 西语词头残损不可释读、闽南音写栏多音节杂记且有污损声调记号，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 屈落下；蹲伏躲下、屈身藏于背后〔音写残损〕
entries.en: to crouch down behind; to duck out of sight (phonetic columns partly smudged)
entries.notes: 闽南与官话两栏音写均有污损难辨处，据西语 esconderse detrás a las espaldas 与汉字「屈落下」判定。
